mechanism_narrative: Lockdown restrictions on non-essential retail directly suppress RETAIL_REC; given RETAIL_REC already at -40 and restrictions tightening, retail will remain lower over the next 4 weeks.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC falls below -35 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days exceeds -25 even as WORKPLACES remains below -30.

mechanism_narrative: Transit collapse indicates reduced mobility to retail destinations; as TRANSIT stays below -60, RETAIL_REC will continue below its last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises by more than 10 points from t-0w while TRANSIT remains below -60.

mechanism_narrative: Under stay-at-home orders, high RESIDENTIAL indicates people are home, reducing retail trips; with RESIDENTIAL above 15, RETAIL_REC will decline further.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases week-on-week while RESIDENTIAL stays above 15.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction of low TRANSIT and low WORKPLACES amplifies retail decline; both commuting and transit are suppressed, reducing footfall to retail.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 14 days is higher than last 14 days despite TRANSIT < -60 and WORKPLACES < -30.

mechanism_narrative: As lockdown extends, grocery/pharmacy decline signals reduced essential shopping, which spills over to retail; with GROCERY_PHARM negative, RETAIL_REC will stay low.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC improves above -30 while GROCERY_PHARM remains below -5.

mechanism_narrative: Parks decline indicates avoidance of public spaces; when PARKS falls below -30, retail and recreation also drop as people restrict all outings.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises week-on-week while PARKS remains below -30.

mechanism_narrative: Winter seasonal downturn in retail activity, combined with ongoing restrictions, keeps RETAIL_REC below its last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days exceeds last 28-day mean despite winter and PARKS below -20.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between low TRANSIT and high RESIDENTIAL creates a home-centric mobility pattern that suppresses retail; as people stay home and avoid transit, retail footfall declines.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 14 days is higher than last 14 days despite TRANSIT < -60 and RESIDENTIAL > 15.
